req.title: Basic-auth handles special characters
req.statement: The system shall URL-decode <user> and <passwd> path segments before comparing against the supplied Basic credentials.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> must URL-decode path segments before comparing against Basic credentials. Tests must cover: (1) positive path with URL-encoded special chars that decode to valid credentials, (2) negative path where credentials don't match the URL-decoded values, (3) boundary cases with percent-encoded characters at the edge of valid ASCII, (4) decision-table coverage of the boolean short-circuit in check_basic_auth (auth present but wrong user, auth present but wrong password, no auth header). Each test asserts exact status codes and JSON payload fields to kill comparison-mutation and constant-mutation operators.

tests.name: test_basic_auth_url_encoded_special_chars_positive
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Client sends Basic credentials matching URL-decoded path segments
actions: URL-encode a username containing '@' and a password containing '#'
Set Authorization header with the decoded (plain) credentials
expected: JSON body contains authenticated=true and user equal to decoded username
trace: R-HTTPBIN-041: system URL-decodes path segments before comparing
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

raw_user = 'user@domain'
raw_pass = 'p#ss!word'
encoded_user = 'user%40domain'
encoded_pass = 'p%23ss%21word'

creds = base64.b64encode(f'{raw_user}:{raw_pass}'.encode()).decode()
headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}

r = client.get(f'/basic-auth/{encoded_user}/{encoded_pass}', headers=headers)
assert r.status_code == 200
data = r.get_json()
assert data['authenticated'] == True
assert data['user'] == raw_user

import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

raw_user = 'user@domain'
wrong_pass = 'wrongpassword'
encoded_user = 'user%40domain'
encoded_pass = 'p%23ssword'

creds = base64.b64encode(f'{raw_user}:{wrong_pass}'.encode()).decode()
headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}

tests.name: test_basic_auth_encoded_chars_wrong_creds_exact_401
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Client sends the URL-encoded string literally as credentials instead of decoded value
actions: Send Authorization with username='user%40host' (not decoded) and password='p%23ss'
expected: Sending encoded form as credential must fail because path is decoded to 'user@host'/'p#ss'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-041: credentials must match decoded path, not the raw encoded path string
tests.executable:

from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

encoded_user = 'user%40host'
encoded_pass = 'p%23ss'

creds = base64.b64encode(f'{encoded_user}:{encoded_pass}'.encode()).decode()
headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}

r = client.get(f'/basic-auth/{encoded_user}/{encoded_pass}', headers=headers)
assert r.status_code == 401
assert r.status_code != 200
